objective: Join restricted CSV-safe primitive cells while retaining missing positions.

relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Delimited exports are common data preparation.
relevanceRationale.transferable: Field domains and serialization boundaries transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Restricted primitive cells make join sufficient for this beginner task.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Distinguishing restricted joining from general CSV prevents malformed export assumptions.

defects: Calling unrestricted join a CSV writer ignored required quoting for commas, quotes and line breaks.
The domain permitted ambiguity about symbols, nested arrays and objects.
A reverse-after-join implementation passed because input preservation was not checked.
rationale: Keep the exercise small: explicitly restrict strings to CSV-safe cells and allow finite numbers, booleans, null and undefined. State that general quoting is outside scope, rather than introducing an unrelated parser. Tests preserve empty positions, false, zero, spaces and frozen input. Read-only handling is a newly explicit policy. The total text-plus-cell cost model avoids treating arbitrary string output as constant per cell.

defects: Negative or fractional requested counts were not bounded.
An empty-input reuse and deep-copy answer escaped original checks.

objective: Convert positive one-based page bounds to a fresh shallow range.

relevanceRationale.presentDay: slice and bounded index arithmetic remain current.
relevanceRationale.practicalUtility: Pagination is a common application data operation.
relevanceRationale.transferable: One-based to zero-based mapping and exclusive end bounds transfer.
relevanceRationale.audienceFit: Explicit positive integer page inputs avoid unrelated validation work.
relevanceRationale.riskOutcome: Identity and boundary checks prevent modest off-by-one and aliasing errors.

defects: Invalid or imprecisely large page inputs were not ruled out.
Original checks missed returning the caller array for a whole-list page.
Deep-cloned object results passed and the hint supplied the start formula.
rationale: Positive page and size bounds keep arithmetic exact. Fresh empty and whole-list results, preserved repeated object identities, frozen input and a far-out valid page are tested. The revised hint asks for the number of preceding full pages without giving the formula. Reference, junior, senior and independently authored filter variants agree; behavioral grading is not represented as syntax enforcement.
